comments.body:
I checked this on Windows 11 as well: with only the test change, `AllModesPassOnHealthyBackupAsync` fails the 4 `dontCompressRestorePaths=True` cases, and with the fix all 8 pass. The empty prefix matches the restore engine: `RestoreHandler` uses `""` for this option, `GetRestorePathPrefixAsync` returns an empty prefix unchanged, and `CreateRestoreOptions` passes the option on to it.

A small nit: the comment above this block still says the full test "strips the same path prefix as it does for the candidates", which is no longer true with this option.

Thanks for checking on Windows and for the nit. Pushed 648c4d8a3, which updates that comment to mention that the prefix is kept when `dont-compress-restore-paths` is set. Comment-only, no code change.

AI assistance: this change was prepared with Claude Code.
@pcbeingused333, thanks for the fix and thanks @JamBalaya56562 for the review
